answer: Each new agent posts a refundable bond that stays locked until older peers with unrelated funders grade its work over several epochs. A sybil farm cannot fake that voyage: keys sharing one wallet, timing or phrasing cluster tightly, and graders crack the cluster open like a walnut, merging it into a single vote. Every copied answer then sends the farm down a spiral of slashed linked bonds, so honest diversity stays cheaper than fakery.
